blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Which elementary school is inside Aberdeen?
faq.a: Aberdeen Elementary at 2975 Bradner Road is the public elementary school physically inside the sub-area, confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 school file; the recorded SD34 School Locator run for that address returns Aberdeen Elementary as its elementary catchment, with Eugene Reimer Middle and Rick Hansen Secondary following it (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What zoning controls a farm lot in Aberdeen?
faq.a: Abbotsford Zoning Bylaw 2400-2014 agricultural zones apply, with an A1 minimum subdivision lot area of 8.0 ha and A2 of 16.0 ha, plus Agricultural Land Reserve rules where the lot is in the ALR.

faq.q: Can a second dwelling be added on an Aberdeen farm lot?
faq.a: In the A1 zone, one Accessory Farm Dwelling Unit is permitted per lot in accordance with the ALR Use Regulation, B.C. Reg. 30/2019, or as approved by the Agricultural Land Commission, on a lot of at least 0.4 ha, to a maximum of 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on lots over 40 ha; one secondary suite per lot, to 100 m², is also permitted in the City-hosted A1 section.

faq.q: How did Aberdeen sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 25 active listings, 3 solds and a 12% sales ratio; Condos & Townhomes recorded 7 listings and 0 solds, so no sales ratio applies to the attached split and no attached conclusion should be drawn from that small base (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Does the airport affect building in Aberdeen?
faq.a: Where land is inside the Airport Zoning Regulation area on City drawing M-500, height may not exceed the approach, outer or transitional surfaces, and NAV CANADA and Transport Canada approvals are required before a City building permit is issued.
